problems.name: HumanEval_145_order_by_points
problems.code:
def order_by_points(nums)
  digits_sum = ->(n) do
    neg = n < 0 ? -1 : 1
    n = n.abs
    digits = n.digits.reverse
    digits[0] *= neg
    digits.sum
  end
  nums.each_with_index
      .sort_by { |num, index| [digits_sum.call(num), index] }
      .map(&:first)
end

  grid.each_with_index do |row, r|
    row.each_with_index do |v, c|

    end
  end
  r, c = pos

  end
  x = neighbors.map { |nr, nc| grid[nr][nc] }.min

  end
  result
end

problems.name: HumanEval_160_do_algebra
problems.code:
def do_algebra(operator, operand)
  ops = operator.dup
  nums = operand.dup

  # Handle exponentiation first (right-associative)
  i = ops.length - 1
  while i >= 0
    if ops[i] == '**'
      nums[i] = nums[i] ** nums[i + 1]
      nums.delete_at(i + 1)
      ops.delete_at(i)
    end
    i -= 1
  end

  # Handle multiplication and floor division (left-associative)
  i = 0
  while i < ops.length
    if ops[i] == '*' || ops[i] == '//'
      if ops[i] == '*'
        nums[i] = nums[i] * nums[i + 1]
      else
        nums[i] = (nums[i].fdiv(nums[i + 1])).floor
      end
      nums.delete_at(i + 1)
      ops.delete_at(i)
    else
      i += 1
    end
  end

  # Handle addition and subtraction (left-associative)
  result = nums[0]
  ops.each_with_index do |op, idx|
    if op == '+'
      result += nums[idx + 1]
    else
      result -= nums[idx + 1]
    end
  end

  result
end

    assert_equal(8, candidate.call(["//", "*"], [7, 3, 4]))
